nodes.title: North Kolkata
nodes.summary: Four North Kolkata branches at Maniktala (APC Road), Baranagar (B.T. Road), Shyambazar (Bidhan Sarani) and Belgachia (Raja Dinendra St), with IFSC codes ZXIN0002001 to ZXIN0002004.

nodes.title: South Kolkata
nodes.summary: Four South Kolkata branches at Ballygunge (Gariahat Road), Tollygunge (Rashbehari Avenue), Jadavpur (Prince Anwar Shah Rd) and Netaji Nagar (NSC Bose Road), with IFSC codes ZXIN0002101 to ZXIN0002104.

nodes.title: East Kolkata
nodes.summary: Three East Kolkata branches at Salt Lake (Sector II), Anandapur (EM Bypass) and Kestopur (VIP Road), with IFSC codes ZXIN0002201 to ZXIN0002203.

nodes.title: West Kolkata
nodes.summary: Three West Kolkata branches at Behala (Sarat Bose Road), Howrah (Andul Road) and Barisha (James Long Sarani), with IFSC codes ZXIN0002301 to ZXIN0002303.

nodes.title: Central Kolkata
nodes.summary: Three Central Kolkata branches at Park Street, Esplanade (Chowringhee Road) and Dharmatala (Lenin Sarani), with IFSC codes ZXIN0002401 to ZXIN0002403.
